Definition: Best-worst Dice gap across references for a given query: Δ = max_r D_r - min_r D_r
column10: Anti-correlation (Fig 1), RAMP predictor, factorial ANOVA, cross-dataset
column11: Binary label: instability if Δ ≥ 0.05. Also called 'best-worst gap'. Strongly correlated with prediction Jaccard f4 (r=-0.842).

Definition: Fraction of references with Dice < 0.1 for a given query. Also reported as prevalence (P_Cat): fraction of queries with mean Dice < 0.1.
Formula: CFR = (1/K) * Σ_r I[D_r < 0.1]; P_Cat = (1/N) * Σ_q I[mean(D_q) < 0.1]
Used In: Anti-correlation (Fig 1), RAMP predictor, selective prediction, deployment envelope
Notes: Binary label: catastrophic if mean Dice < 0.1. Paper uses both per-query CFR and dataset-level P_Cat. DISCREPANCY: 'over 14% of queries experience catastrophic failure from at least one reference' is ambiguous between CFR and P_Cat (C009).

Definition: Dice similarity coefficient between predicted mask and ground truth: D = 2|A∩B| / (|A|+|B|)
Used In: All experiments: baselines, RAMP, RRN, external comparison, cross-dataset
Notes: Per-reference Dice. Mean Dice across references: D̄ = (1/K)Σ_r D_r. Success threshold: Dice ≥ 0.5 for RRE. Baseline DINOv2-L+SAM-B Dice=0.446 (C008).

Definition: Area under the ROC curve for predicting binary instability label (Δ ≥ 0.05) from pipeline features.
Notes: Measures detection of unstable queries. Ranges 0.831-1.000 across ablations. Claim: ≥0.994 across all segmenters (C012) - WP1 only tested SAM2-S. All segmenter values from Phase T need confirmation.

Definition: Area under the precision-recall curve for predicting binary catastrophic label (mean Dice < 0.1) from pipeline features.
Notes: Measures detection of catastrophic queries. Ranges 0.250-0.997 across ablations. Claim: ≥0.893 across all segmenters (C013) - WP1 only tested SAM2-S. f4 removal drops Cat_AP from 0.966 to 0.250 (C042).

Definition: Percentage reduction in CFR at a given coverage level: CFR_Red = (CFR_full - CFR_accepted) / CFR_full × 100%
Used In: RAMP selective prediction (Tables 1-3,6,8-9,11-12), component ablation, external comparison
Notes: Evaluated at 80% coverage. RAMP range: 37.5-84.4% (corrected from 56-84%, C004). Oracle upper bound: 77-89%. MC Dropout: 10.7% (C027). Deep Ensemble: 6.3% (C028).

Definition: Area under the ROC curve for predicting per-reference success (Dice ≥ 0.5) from pipeline features.
Notes: RRN AUROC=0.612 (C018). Random=0.500. Similarity=0.536. Used for RRE success prediction. Trained on 70/15/15 split, only 12 test queries.

Definition: UNKNOWN - NOT explicitly defined in paper for per-reference use
Used In: Not explicitly used in paper for per-reference task
Notes: Paper uses AUPRC only for anti-correlation detection (Cat_AP). Per-reference AUPRC not reported. NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

Definition: Fraction of test episodes accepted by selective predictor: coverage = 1 - abstention_rate
Notes: All CFR_Red values reported at 80% coverage. Coverage-based ranking does not require fixed probability threshold. Used instead of calibration.

Definition: Measures calibration of predicted probabilities: ECE = Σ_b (|B_b|/N) * |acc(B_b) - conf(B_b)|
Notes: MoNuSAC ECE=0.027 (well-calibrated). MoNuSeg ECE=0.060. IDRID ECE=0.477 (severe miscalibration). IDRID ECE contradicts calibration-free claim (C006).

Definition: Correlation between instability and CFR after controlling for mean Dice. Used in validity Control D.
Notes: r_partial = -0.25, 95% CI [-0.41, -0.07]. Indicates association persists after controlling for overall difficulty, but is substantially weaker than coupled correlation (r=-0.62).

Definition: Pearson product-moment correlation coefficient between two variables.
Formula: r = Σ(x_i - x̄)(y_i - ȳ) / sqrt(Σ(x_i - x̄)² * Σ(y_i - ȳ)²)
Notes: Used for instability-CFR anti-correlation. Claimed range: r=-0.43 to -0.71 (C001). Corrected range: r=-0.18 to -0.49. Cross-dataset values: MoNuSAC r=-0.67 (in Table 12, but contradicts r=-0.491 in theory_verification, C053).

Definition: Mean Dice when selecting the top-3 references by a given strategy.
column7: RRN=0.525 (C019). Similarity=0.516 (C020). Oracle=0.588 (C021). Random=0.501. Used to evaluate reference selection strategies.

Definition: Variance of the top-k point coordinates around their centroid.
Notes: Directly measures σ²_i from geometric hypotheses. Feature f3 = prompt overlap (spatial).

Definition: Mean Euclidean distance from the top-k points to the nearest ground-truth target pixel.
Notes: Used in H2. Bounded by triangle inequality: PLE ≤ σ + d*. Not directly reported as a numeric metric in results tables.
